title: Picky Relics
description:
This mod is similar to Bossy Relics, but highly configurable. Relic rewards will provide one choice out of many.

You can configure how each tier of relic behaves separately. For example, if the original rewarded relic was Common tier provide 3 other options, but if the original reward is Rare, only provide 1 other option.

The additional relic choices are normally the same tier as the reward; but you can change that behavior too. Additional choices can be configured to always be lower tier, always higher tier, or some combination of both using probabilities.

My native language is English, so I apologize for any translation issues. They are AI generated and all corrections are welcome!

每种遗物类型可配置0到5个选项。你还可以选择遗物是否有机会比原来的等级更高或更低。

각 유물 유형별로 0개에서 5개까지 선택지를 설정할 수 있습니다. 또한 유물이 원래 등급보다 높거나 낮은 등급이 될 확률을 설정할 수도 있습니다.
